description: This platform’s oil balance model run on its live inputs: the lever set, a summary, and the monthly path of anchor, price, band, demand, supply, stock change and inventories, with the source and status of every input. scenario: base, tight (stronger demand against tighter supply), transition (weaker demand with more displacement) or flood (more supply and more elastic shale). The path is modelled and indicative; the inputs and the anchor are published data.
name: oil_balance
title: Oil balance model
